original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚奥约州警方解救一名15岁被绑架男孩
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚奥约州警方在Awe-Iwo公路沿线开展协同安全行动，解救了一名15岁被绑架男孩Sumaila Muhammadu，并在交火中击毙一名疑似绑匪。警方称行动基于可靠情报，嫌疑人先向安全人员开火。目前仅有一个来源报道此事，被击毙嫌疑人身份尚未确认。

location.raw_text: Awe–Iwo Road axis, Oyo State, Ibadan

key_facts.fact: 奥约州警方解救了一名15岁被绑架男孩Sumaila Muhammadu
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Oyo State Police command has rescued a 15-year-old kidnapped boy, identified as Sumaila Muhammadu

key_facts.fact: 行动中一名疑似绑匪在交火中被击毙
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: one yet-to-be-identified suspected kidnapper was neutralised
during a coordinated security operation along the Awe–Iwo Road axis of the state

key_facts.fact: 警方称行动基于10月22日获得的情报
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the operation followed credible intelligence received by the command on Thursday, October 22, 2026

uncertainties: 被击毙嫌疑人身份尚未确认
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
